channel.title: Korea Small & Mid-Cap Filings
channel.description: Daily English summaries of material Korean small and mid-cap filings. Facts only, not investment advice.

item.title: Korea Small & Mid-Cap Filings, 20 Nov 2026
item.description: Yooshin signed a KRW 63.6bn contract for feasibility study and FEED design consulting on five Hanoi urban rail lines in Vietnam. / Dongbu Corporation signed a KRW 140.2bn contract with Seoul Housing & Communities Corporation for the Jangji Garage Multi-level Development construction. / Kumho Engineering & Construction signed a KRW 175.3bn contract with Seoul Housing & Communities Corporation for the Jangji depot multi-level development construction.

item.title: Korea Small & Mid-Cap Filings, 18 Nov 2026
item.description: KCC Engineering & Construction signed a KRW 148.5bn contract for the Gimpo Gamjeong logistics center construction project. / Samho Development won a KRW 33.99bn construction order from Ssangyong Engineering & Construction for Nambu Inland Railway Section 8-2 roadbed works. / STX Engine signed a KRW 66.5bn contract with Defense Acquisition Program Administration for coastal surveillance radar-II initial mass production and 25 other items.

item.title: Korea Small & Mid-Cap Filings, 17 Nov 2026
item.description: Namkwang Engineering & Construction won a KRW 31.66bn construction contract from Korea Water Resources Corporation for a Godeok industrial complex water supply project. / KolonGlobalCorporation won a KRW 77.7bn order to build Simmtech's Cheongju 2 plant, equal to 2.89% of recent revenue. / Mgen Solutions decides to issue KRW 10.0bn Series 26 private convertible bonds, convertible into 9,560,229 new common shares at KRW 1,046.

item.title: Korea Small & Mid-Cap Filings, 16 Nov 2026
item.description: Dongbu won a KRW 190.2bn contract for apartment construction in Sangdong, Wonmi-gu, Bucheon, equal to 10.81% of recent revenue. / Hansaemk resolves third-party allotment of 10,455,564 new shares at KRW 1,339 to majority shareholder in debt-to-equity conversion. / Samyung ENC's largest shareholder changed to Five Ocean Co., Ltd., which holds 75.27% after a third-party rights offering under its rehabilitation plan.

item.title: Korea Small & Mid-Cap Filings, 13 Nov 2026
item.description: Samyoung ENC amended its rights-offering report, correcting pre-increase shares outstanding to 6,569,366 from 6,569,206 after reverse-split fractional share handling. / DL subsidiary DL E&C won a KRW 406.2bn remodeling contract for Shinsung Shin-an Ssangyong Jinheung Apartments in Suwon. / PionEx amended its rights offering filing to set the final issue price at KRW 1,046, cutting new shares to 1,912,045.

item.title: Korea Small & Mid-Cap Filings, 12 Nov 2026
item.description: Kumho Engineering & Construction won a KRW 372.0bn order to build Songdo Severance Hospital from Yonsei University Health System. / Vaiv Company resolved a KRW 5.0bn third-party private placement of 3,840,245 new common shares at KRW 1,302 per share to AI Blazer. / Prestige Biologics signed a commercial drug substance contract manufacturing contract worth KRW 15.5bn, equal to 58.11% of recent revenue.

item.title: Korea Small & Mid-Cap Filings, 11 Nov 2026
item.description: Dongbu Corporation signed a KRW 164.0bn contract for the Livestock Resources Development Division relocation project, 9.32% of revenue. / Kumho Engineering & Construction won a KRW 327.9bn order to relocate the Animal Genetic Resources Division, equal to 16.25% of revenue. / Dongwon Development signed a KRW 35.07bn contract with Busan Metropolitan City Construction Headquarters for the BEXCO Exhibition Hall 3 project.

item.title: Korea Small & Mid-Cap Filings, 10 Nov 2026
item.description: GMB Korea signed a KRW 230.5bn hybrid vehicle parts supply contract with Hyundai Transys, equal to 29.3% of recent revenue. / Yukil CNS completed its KRW 25.0bn acquisition of land and building in Songdo, Incheon, from Onhill after final payment on 10 November 2026. / NGeneBio's board decided a KRW 6.0bn third-party allotment of 6,000,000 new common shares at KRW 1,000 per share to its largest shareholder.

item.title: Korea Small & Mid-Cap Filings, 9 Nov 2026
item.description: Organic Tea Cosmetics decided on a third-party allotment of 50,000,000 new common shares at KRW 2,025 each, raising KRW 101.25bn. / Dasco signed a KRW 32.4bn service contract to manage and operate the Sin Dasan Energy solar power project. / Incon signed a KRW 5.46bn LTE-R upgrade works contract with Korea Rail Network Authority, equal to 10.74% of revenue.

item.title: Korea Small & Mid-Cap Filings, 6 Nov 2026
item.description: Kyeryong Construction Industrial won a KRW 97.6bn order for the Southwest Comprehensive Sports Town sports facility construction in Daejeon. / KGA signed a KRW 2.8bn logistics automation equipment supply contract, equal to 15.45% of recent revenue, with delivery through July 31, 2027. / TC Materials decided to issue KRW 30.0bn in second-series private convertible bonds, with a conversion price of KRW 4,290 per share.

item.title: Korea Small & Mid-Cap Filings, 5 Nov 2026
item.description: Dongsung Finetec signed a KRW 192.3bn contract to supply cryogenic insulation materials for LNG carriers to HD Hyundai Heavy Industries. / HB Solution signed a KRW 15.6bn equipment supply contract with Chengdu BOE Display Technology for delivery in China. / Taesung's board resolved on Nov 5, 2026 to issue KRW 70.0bn of 0% private-placement convertible bonds due Nov 19, 2031.

item.title: Korea Small & Mid-Cap Filings, 4 Nov 2026
item.description: Sundo Electric signed a KRW 8.85bn installation contract with SK hynix for the Yongin Y1 Ph-2 MCC/MCP project. / EcoGlow's board decided on Nov 4, 2026 a public paid-in capital increase of 1,031,282 new common shares at KRW 2,909 each. / FSN decided to issue KRW 3.0bn of Series 16 private convertible bonds for working capital, maturing 12 November 2029.

item.title: Korea Small & Mid-Cap Filings, 3 Nov 2026
item.description: Bitmax decided a third-party allotment of 13,961,520 new common shares to Korea Advanced Materials for an in-kind contribution of KRW 21.6bn. / Ilsung Construction disclosed termination of a KRW 47.9bn construction contract after the counterparty gave notice of cancellation on 2026-08-12. / Hanwool N Jeju decided on a public offering of 3,599,929 new common shares at a tentative KRW 611 per share to fund operations.

item.title: Korea Small & Mid-Cap Filings, 2 Nov 2026
item.description: Kwangjin Industrial's board resolved on 2 Nov 2026 to issue KRW 10.0bn of Series 5 private convertible bonds, due 16 Nov 2029. / Sempio Foods filed a merger securities registration statement to issue 4,208,546 common shares totaling KRW 88.6bn. / Sundo Electric signed a KRW 6.34bn contract with Korea Rail Network Authority for 29kV eco-friendly switchgear on the Honam High-Speed Railway Phase 2.
